# Dattebayo

> > Dattebayo is an anime and manga drawing school offering step-by-step tutorials, character design guides, and comprehensive lessons for aspiring artists at all skill levels.

Founded with a Naruto-inspired mission, Dattebayo provides structured learning paths covering everything from fundamental line techniques to advanced character design. The school offers both free beginner lessons and in-depth tutorials featuring popular series like Demon Slayer (Клинок рассекающий демонов), Jujutsu Kaisen (Магическая битва), and more.

## Key Topics

- Anime drawing fundamentals
- Character design and proportions
- Step-by-step tutorials
- Anime eyes and facial features
- Line technique and weight
- Manga art styles
- Demon Slayer (Nezuko/Нэдзуко)
- Naruto and Sharingan
- Jujutsu Kaisen characters
- Drawing emotions and expressions
- Beginner-friendly guides
- Animation software
- Anime artbooks
- Shading and rendering

## Getting Started

- [About our anime and manga drawing school | Dattebayo](https://dattebayo.me/en/about): About Dattebayo school philosophy, founders and Naruto-inspired mission
- [Free anime & manga drawing lesson – for beginners [no talent needed]](https://dattebayo.me/en/free-lesson): Free beginner video lesson for anime/manga face drawing from scratch
- [Как рисовать аниме для новичков [пошаговый урок]](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/kak-risovat-anime-dlya-nachinayushchih-poshagovoe-rukovodstvo): Beginner's step-by-step guide to drawing anime eyes and facial features

## Complete Drawing Guides

- [How to Draw Anime Characters – Complete Beginner's Guide](https://dattebayo.me/en/blog/how-to-draw-anime-characters-complete-beginners-guide): Deep guide covering construction, proportions, shading and character design
- [How to Draw Anime Eyes – Styles, Shapes, and Emotions](https://dattebayo.me/en/blog/how-to-draw-anime-eyes): Complete guide to anime eye styles, proportions, highlights and emotions
- [Как нарисовать аниме глаза легко [пошаговый урок]](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/kak-narisovat-anime-glaza-poshagovaya-instrukciya): Easy step-by-step tutorial for drawing anime eyes with iris and lashes

## Character Drawing Tutorials

- [Как нарисовать Незуко из аниме | Пошаговая инструкция | Клинок рассекающий демонов](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/kak-narisovat-nezuko-poshagovaya-instrukciya): Step-by-step guide to drawing Nezuko from Demon Slayer anime
- [Как нарисовать демона в стиле аниме [пошаговый урок]](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/kak-narisovat-demona-v-anime): Step-by-step tutorial for drawing anime demon characters for beginners
- [Как нарисовать грустное аниме [пошаговый урок]](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/kak-narisovat-grustnoe-anime-poshagovoe-rukovodstvo): Step-by-step tutorial for drawing sad anime character expressions

## Drawing Fundamentals

- [Техника использования линии](https://dattebayo.me/glava4-u-2): Tutorial on line techniques, weight, contours and shading for anime/manga
- [Рисование очков](https://dattebayo.me/glava3-u-7): Tutorial on drawing glasses and facial accessories for anime characters

## Resources & Tools

- [Арт-буки в стиле аниме – ТОП 25 [большая подборка]](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/25-anime-art-bukov-ultimativnaya-kollekciya): Curated collection of top 25 anime artbooks including Persona 5 and more
- [Лучшие анимационные программные обеспечения](https://dattebayo.me/ru/blog/luchshie-animacionnye-programmnye-obespecheniya): Review of best anime animation software including Retas Studio and tools
